entry.title: Democrats to Push Broader Crypto Market Structure Bill After Sweeping US Midterms: Report
entry.summary: Analysts said that the Clarity Act's path has become tougher, while advocacy group Stand With Crypto has endorsed 27 winning candidates so far.

entry.title: Bitcoin Erases Election Rally as AI Stocks Plunge, $428 Million in Crypto Longs Get Wiped Out
entry.summary: Bitcoin plunged nearly 5% as AI stocks sank, Democratic midterm wins raised fresh policy questions, and forced liquidations erased a Wednesday rally that had been fueled partly by short covering.

entry.title: Sam Altman Says It's 'Fucking Annoying' His RAM Comments Were Taken Out of Context
entry.summary: The OpenAI CEO briefly renamed himself "Ram Altman" on X after Elon Musk mocked him for saying idle home PC memory is "quite terrible."

entry.title: Morning Minute: Democrat Sweep Pumps Crypto as Clarity Act Resurfaces
entry.summary: The Dems are already talking compromise on the Clarity Act and their requests all seem logical - does the bill have new life?

entry.title: Stablecoins Go Mainstream as Samsung Wallet Adds USDC on Solana
entry.summary: Eligible U.S. Galaxy users can now buy, hold, send and receive USDC on Solana directly in Samsung Wallet, without a separate crypto app or private keys to manage.

entry.title: Binance Cuts Off SignalPlus API Keys Over 'Potential Security Issue' at Trading Platform
entry.summary: The exchange said its own systems and user funds are unaffected, a week after it lost $6.4 billion in a hack blamed on North Korea.

entry.title: Canadian Man Extradited to US Over Plot to Hijack University Supercomputers for Crypto
entry.summary: Prosecutors say Ryan Roach and a co-defendant targeted U.S. universities with supercomputers, stealing logins and secretly mining crypto.

entry.title: Arkansas Sues Kalshi, Joining a Growing List of States Targeting Prediction Markets
entry.summary: Attorney General Tim Griffin said betting on "whether the Razorbacks win or lose" is gambling, and wants restitution, penalties and taxes.

entry.title: Why Bitcoin's Next Soft Fork Could Feel Like a Practice Run
entry.summary: Matt Corallo explains why patching four legacy bugs is about rebuilding muscle memory, just as much as it’s about Bitcoin maintenance.

entry.title: ChatGPT Is Getting a GIF Maker Powered by OpenAI's Unannounced Images 2.6 Model
entry.summary: OpenAI is rolling out animated GIF creation in ChatGPT, with frame-by-frame editing and speed controls.

entry.title: Google Tells Schools They Can Reject AI—But They'll Lose Search, Too
entry.summary: Google is giving schools more control over Gemini, but districts that want Search without AI are out of luck, fueling accusations that the company is pressuring educators into adopting AI.

entry.title: Coinbase Says 99% of Customer Crypto Is Offline and Out of Hackers’ Reach
entry.summary: Coinbase told customers it wasn’t affected by the $6.4 billion Binance hack and detailed its security controls, including offline storage for over 99% of assets, split private keys and kill switches.

entry.title: US Bank Regulator Issues First AI Framework as Banks Battle Rogue Agents
entry.summary: The OCC's first examiner guide weighs autonomy and financial harm, and directly addresses outside AI agents—the same risk that recently prompted major banks to restrict customer-account access.

entry.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
entry.summary: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.

entry.title: Canton Coin Gets SEC Nod as Wall Street Tokenization Heats Up
entry.summary: SEC staff said they view Canton Coin as a digital commodity and won’t recommend enforcement over how it’s minted, a week after DTCC launched a tokenization service that runs partly on the Canton Network.

entry.title: What Is x402? How AI Agents Pay With Crypto
entry.summary: Coinbase's x402 protocol puts the web's long-unused 402 code to work so AI agents and apps can pay for APIs and data in stablecoins like USDC.

entry.title: Tech, AI Stocks Split After Democratic Sweep: Microsoft Jumps, Tesla and Nvidia Tank
entry.summary: Microsoft and Alphabet surged while Nvidia and Tesla fell, highlighting a divided market as investors reassess Washington's approach to AI and Big Tech.

entry.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Democratic Midterm Sweep, But Crypto Faces Tougher Fight in Washington
entry.summary: Bitcoin bounced back after Democrats won control of Congress, but a stalled market structure bill and heavy industry campaign spending reveal crypto’s exposure to shifting US political power.

entry.title: Wall Street’s Plumbing Goes Onchain as Morgan Stanley Tokenizes Securities
entry.summary: Morgan Stanley says it has converted U.S. equities and Treasuries into tokenized form through the newly launched DTCC Tokenization Service, which 20 Wall Street firms have signed up to use.

entry.title: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa Confirms Cyberattack After ZachXBT Ties It to $133M Crypto Theft
entry.summary: The French bank said the attack allowed "fraudulent operations" but did not mention crypto, and is still assessing the amounts.

entry.summary: Plus, pro-crypto spending largely failed to produce results as the Democrats swept the Senate and House in Midterms.

entry.title: Bitcoin Shrugs Off Midterms as Experts Say Democratic Sweep Was 'Priced In'
entry.summary: Experts say the Democratic sweep was largely priced in, but it makes the road ahead harder for crypto policy.

entry.title: USDC Issuer Circle Quietly Cuts 5% of Staff in Profitable Quarter
entry.summary: The USDC issuer disclosed the cuts in its earnings release, booking $9.1 million in restructuring costs as reserve income fell 8%.

entry.title: Midterms Blue Wave Makes $917K for One Polymarket Trader, If Alaska Doesn’t Flip
entry.summary: A Polymarket trader topped the prediction market’s leaderboard after Democrats swept the US midterms, but Alaska could still flip it.

entry.title: Judge Orders Bitcoin Wallet Returned to Family of Convicted Canadian Killer
entry.summary: A Nova Scotia judge found prosecutors failed to link William Sandeson's Bitcoin to the 2015 murder of fellow student Taylor Samson.

entry.title: OpenAI Wants to Rebrand AI Data Centers, Use Them to 'Protect the Grid'
entry.summary: The ChatGPT maker says future facilities could ease pressure on power grids by cutting demand during emergencies.

entry.title: Tether Holds 150,000 Bitcoin, CEO Says—About 50,000 More Than Its Reserve Report Shows
entry.summary: Paolo Ardoino told the Plan ₿ Forum in Lugano the company owns “give or take 150,000 Bitcoin,” but its Q3 reserve report implies just 100,060.

entry.title: Anthropic's AI Is Getting Cheaper to Use. That's Becoming a Problem for Its Business
entry.summary: Claude's prices are falling, but Anthropic's computing expenses grew faster than sales in the latest quarter—a tricky equation ahead of its IPO.

entry.title: CrowdStrike Launches AI Agent 'Kill Switch,' Plans to Acquire Fiddler AI
entry.summary: CrowdStrike's new kill switch lets security teams cut off unauthorized AI agents through a gateway, while its planned Fiddler acquisition aims to make autonomous software easier to monitor and audit.

entry.title: Justin Sun Accuses Trump-Backed World Liberty of Using UAE Ties to Escape Federal Court
entry.summary: Tron founder Justin Sun said he has asked a federal court to sanction World Liberty Financial, alleging the Trump family-backed venture delayed disclosing UAE ties that could defeat federal jurisdiction over his lawsuit.

entry.title: Crypto Docs Host GitBook Hit by AI Agent Security Breach, Urges Users to Rotate Keys
entry.summary: GitBook says attackers accessed infrastructure credentials in an AI-assisted breach, prompting a shutdown and emergency token resets.

entry.title: CFTC Lets Traders Bet on Stocks With Crypto-Style Perpetual Futures
entry.summary: Chairman Michael Selig said “equity perpetual futures” can now trade on CFTC-registered exchanges, extending a crypto-native instrument to traditional stocks.

entry.title: Brazil's Biggest Bitcoin Exchange Says It Will Refund Users After a $40 Million Hack
entry.summary: Mercado Bitcoin says customers won't pay for a hack that drained tens of millions. Withdrawals on the exchange remain frozen with no restart date.

entry.title: Elon Musk’s Tesla and SpaceX Block Their Stock From OKX-ICE Tokenized Venue
entry.summary: Amazon, Tesla, SpaceX, Netflix, Lam Research, and SoFi objected to trading of their shares on the planned OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue, bringing the total to 56.

entry.title: Five Ways North Korea Breaks Into Crypto Firms—and How Binance Was Hacked
entry.summary: From AI deepfakes to poisoning code libraries: here's how North Korean hackers get inside crypto companies.

entry.title: Epidemic of Hacked Freezers Spreads Across Europe
entry.summary: A suspected hacking wave has pushed supermarket freezers into defrost mode across ten European countries, with temperatures reportedly hitting 50°C. Nobody knows who's behind it or why it spread.

entry.title: UK Says AI-Powered Ransomware Attack on Critical Infrastructure 'Highly Likely' by 2028
entry.summary: The National Cyber Security Centre said AI will expose security flaws "tolerated for far too long," and called time on "tech on the cheap."
